actions.value: . /home/probe/session-env; set -eu; date -u +%FT%T.%N; out=/home/probe/evidence/capture-round6; mkdir -p "$out"; ps -p 34063 -o pid,lstart,args; cat /proc/34063/stat; timeout 15 /usr/bin/python3 /home/probe/source-input/geometry-oracle/snapshot-guest.py > "$out/compositor-oracle.json" 2> "$out/compositor-oracle.stderr"; cat "$out/compositor-oracle.json" "$out/compositor-oracle.stderr"; if timeout 25 /usr/bin/python3 /home/probe/source-input/geometry-oracle/atspi-snapshot.py --pid 34063 --max-nodes 2000 --max-depth 8 > "$out/shell-screenshot-ui-shallow.jsonl" 2> "$out/shell-screenshot-ui-shallow.stderr"; then tree_rc=0; else tree_rc=$?; fi; cat "$out/shell-screenshot-ui-shallow.jsonl" "$out/shell-screenshot-ui-shallow.stderr"; printf 'ROUND6_SHELL_UI_SHALLOW_TREE_EXIT=%s\n' "$tree_rc"; test "$tree_rc" -eq 0; printf 'ROUND6_SCREEN_STATE_READOUT_COMPLETE\n'
